title: Enhanced anti-spoofing for facial recognition must be enabled on Window 10.
check_content:
Windows 10 v1507 LTSB version does not include this setting; it is NA for those systems.

If the following registry value does not exist or is not configured as specified, this is a finding:

Registry Hive: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE
Registry Path: \SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Biometrics\FacialFeatures\

Value Name: EnhancedAntiSpoofing

Value Type: REG_DWORD
Value: 0x00000001 (1)
fixtext:
Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> Biometrics >> Facial Features >> "Configure enhanced anti-spoofing" to "Enabled". 

v1607:
The policy name is "Use enhanced anti-spoofing when available".
VulnDiscussion: Enhanced anti-spoofing provides additional protections when using facial recognition with devices that support it.
